sub_graphs.title: Ethereum Package: EVM Recursion Limit

nodes.label: Check Recursion Limit

nodes.label: Within Recursion Limit

nodes.description: Call depth has reached or exceeded 12288

ambiguities.text: The EVM_RECURSION_LIMIT is set to 12288 (1024 * 12) but the rationale for this specific value is not documented.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 1024 is the historical call depth limit and the 12x multiplier provides headroom for internal operations. The exact value is implementation-specific.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between EVM_RECURSION_LIMIT and the EIP-150 call depth limit (1024) is not clarified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EVM_RECURSION_LIMIT is a Python-specific safeguard for the reference implementation, while EIP-150's 1024 limit is enforced via gas mechanics. Both limits may apply.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Python execution environment has sufficient stack space to handle 12288 levels of function recursion.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Python's default recursion limit is typically 1000. If not increased, the reference implementation would crash before reaching EVM_RECURSION_LIMIT.

implicit_assumptions.description: The version string accurately reflects the specification version implemented.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Version mismatches could cause interoperability issues or incorrect behavior expectations.
